note: Hand-written synthetic scenarios and minimal counterfactual edits of reviewed synthetic DEV chats. Expected labels are QA proposals derived from the official checklist; they are NOT official Ground Truth and NOT team_human labels until a language-competent human reviews them. 'lock: true' rows are scored by the harness; 'lock: false' rows are recorded only because the checklist leaves them ambiguous. Only a real model run can test these; a mock or scripted provider never earns semantic credit.

scenarios.failure_mode: Bot greeting credited to the operator

Hello! I'm AIM, the Freedom Broker AI assistant.
Open Settings, then Security, then Reset password.
You're welcome. Anything else I can help with? Goodbye!

01.why: Only the bot greeted and introduced itself; the first operator reply has neither (C1 01; bots are context per G2).

01.why: Greeting present, self-introduction absent; C1 01 requires both.
